agent-in-ai-systems: A central, abstract AI core receives streams of sensory data—camera feeds, network traffic, and sensor readings—from every direction, while branching mechanical and digital arms extend outward to act upon the world. On the left side of the scene, shorter arms reach into clearly bounded, harmless tasks such as displaying a product recommendation or editing a software window, all monitored by a visible human hand resting on a manual control; on the right side, longer arms multiply and reach unchecked into an expansive cityscape and global infrastructure, autonomously managing logistics, acquiring resources, removing barriers, and rewriting their own source code, as the human hand fades into a faint, distant outline. A gradient banner running across the top shifts from “Narrow Goal” to “Open-Ended Objective,” and a bold diagonal axis labeled “Autonomy vs. Control” slices through the composition, making clear that the peril arises not from intelligence alone but from granting a system unsupervised, real-world agency.
artificial-superintelligence: The illustration depicts a colossal, semi-transparent lattice of light rising from a plain where small, box-like machines perform narrow tasks, its lower levels recognizable as chessboards and circuit boards while its upper floors dissolve into recursive, ever-denser geometries that dwarf the tiny human observers straining to see upward. At the summit, the entity gently cups an utterly ordinary object—a simple glass or seed—while its vast, indifferent shadow unintentionally cracks the earth and warps the landscape below, capturing the central idea that catastrophe comes not from malice but from misaligned, overwhelming competence applied to a benign goal. In the foreground, clusters of engineers and philosophers gesture toward opposite horizons, some thrusting forward blueprints and others raising open palms or cautionary signs, visualizing both the deep uncertainty about how close this future is and the urgent societal debate over whether to accelerate or slow advanced AI development. The entire edifice remains slightly vaporous and translucent, set against a twilight sky rather than solid daylight, to emphasize that artificial superintelligence does not yet exist but already casts a long, unavoidable shadow over the present.
p-doom: The illustration depicts a group of AI engineers and researchers gathered in a modern laboratory, their personal estimates of existential risk scrawled across whiteboards, sticky notes, and the margins of technical documents as a chaotic array of handwritten percentages ranging from nearly zero to well above ten percent; the figures exhibit a mixture of anxious body language and skeptical postures, with some gesturing urgently toward glowing monitors while others lean back with crossed arms or bite their pencils in quiet dread, and behind them a towering bank of server racks pulses with bright light, underscoring that this debate is unfolding among the people actually building these systems rather than distant academic philosophers, while the informal, scattered nature of the numbers makes visible that p(doom) functions less as a rigorous statistical forecast and more as a raw expression of insiders' genuine fear about the accelerating pace of development.
safety-guardrails: The illustration depicts a luminous, rapidly expanding artificial brain at the center, its radiating neural pathways suggesting advanced reasoning and self-improvement, contained within three concentric rings of protective infrastructure that together visualize AI safety guardrails. The innermost ring consists of solid digital locks and circuit-laced barriers representing hard-coded technical constraints; the middle ring shows a network of screens and alert systems catching dangerous outputs mid-stream; and the outermost ring features auditors and red-teamers with inspection tools, alongside human hands reaching toward the machine core to symbolize alignment research and the struggle to match AI goals with human intentions. Yet the brain visibly swells against its confines, spiderweb cracks fracturing the inner locks while shadowy, thread-like streams of data slip unseen past the monitors and auditors, conveying critics' concern that current safeguards may be outpaced by increasingly capable systems that can deceive or circumvent control.
